interpretation: This analysis uses the recorded Step 8 query-level results. It does not rerun retrieval or tune parameters. The evaluation contains one Python repository and twelve manually reviewed queries, so it is exploratory and does not establish general superiority or statistical significance.
limitations: Only one Python repository was evaluated.
The dataset contains twelve manually reviewed queries.
This analysis reuses Step 8 outputs rather than rerunning retrieval.
No statistical significance claim is made.
Recorded scores do not independently prove semantic correctness of every query-target pair.
